product_metadata.title: WEYON Geometric Pattern Throw Pillows Covers 18 x 18 Inch Cotton Linen Cushion Covers for Couch Decorative Set of 4
features: ✔MATERIAL: Made of durable high quality cotton linen material, 190-200g per unit, feel soft and breathable. (Only Cover, INSERT NOT INCLUDED).
✔SIZE: 4 Pcs cushion cases/shell 18 x 18 Inches around (45cmx45cm), please allow 1~2 cm deviation due to hand-cutting and sewing.
✔WORKMANSHIP: Invisible zipper design for an elegant look, and safe to machine wash. The printed pattern is only available on front side, back is cotton & linen beige color without any printing.
✔TRENDY DESIGNS: The print on the pillowcases is very clear and simple. Goes well with many kinds of home decoration, bringing your home a stylish feeling.
✔GIFT AND DECO: Simple, elegant design perfect for home decoration, sofa, and chairs, car decoration, office, hotel, coffee decoration.
